title: Catch Piggy: Toy Pile Match
description: A physics heap of plump pink piggies, teddy bears and colorful toys tumbles across the screen — snatch matching triples before the clock runs dry.
controls: Tap toys and piggies into your 7-slot tray to match triples. Hit Freeze, Auto-Match, or Pop-Out when the tray fills up.

zh-CN.title: 抓小猪：全堆里揪三只
zh-CN.description: 一整堆软萌小猪屁股、泰迪熊和玩具咕噜咕噜滚满屏幕！眼疾手快翻出三个一模一样的凑对消掉，倒计时嘀嗒作响，越抓越上头。
zh-CN.controls: 点击画面里露出的小猪或玩具放进底部 7 格托盘，集齐 3 个自动消除；危机时刻点「冰冻」「凑齐」「移出」极限救命！
